fcpr:5e96abdea75319cf391f03a129488b0a749.rationale: The universal quantification over arbitrary nonempty families F includes degenerate families containing edgeless graphs, for which no F-free graphs exist and familyExtremalNumber/extremalNumber collapse to the junk value 0 (sup over an empty set), cases the informal ex(n;F) notion does not cover.

fcpr:1743add1b050bbae87257794a29f68ad2d7.rationale: The informal 'a sufficiently close' means ∃ δ > 0 such that the property holds for all a within δ of (1+1/k)k^{1/(k+1)}, but the formal statement only asserts ∀ δ > 0 ∃ a within δ (a single witness per δ, which could even be the center point every time), a strictly weaker quantifier arrangement.

fcpr:a068a0b37e7092784c4d06f8f9ac42bc6b1.rationale: The informal statement asserts the bound for every k-uniform hypergraph with k ≥ 3, but the formal statement fixes k = 3 (ThreeUniformHypergraph), an extra restriction that yields only a special case.

fcpr:9849b4eb5de6928bae4627aa09f42531334.rationale: The statement hinges entirely on the auxiliary definition IsCoprimeNonrepresentable, which per the reviewer fails to capture the informal notion of representability (sums of p^k q^l terms forming a divisibility antichain, with n coprime), though the definition itself is not shown so the exact divergence cannot be pinpointed.

fcpr:9742b2b9e523562258bb6783606c33dad69.rationale: The abbreviation delegates to gameLength, which (per the reviewer hint and its noncomputable ℕ-valued form) is presumably defined via sSup/sInf of a possibly empty or unbounded set of play lengths, so it can silently return a Lean junk value (0) instead of the intended game length on {2,…,n}.

The docstring claims a genuine game-value definition unfolding the game tree, but the formal body is just `sorry`, an uninterpreted placeholder that captures none of the described minimax semantics (the wrong-connective hint does not apply since no connective appears).

The informal position is just a claimed set plus the full unclaimed pool, but the extra `pool_compatible` field forces every pooled number to be legally playable, so positions with unclaimed-but-unplayable numbers are unrepresentable and the end-of-game/pool-empty condition becomes trivially forced, misdefining the game position.

fcpr:78981183d1c7973f950bd3807381b40a8b0.rationale: The formal statement assumes [Subsingleton G] (a trivial group) instead of the anti-homogeneous hypothesis (distinct conjugacy class sizes), making the theorem trivially true only for a strict special case.

fcpr:fbe4917de96511a6553e58144d59814110c.rationale: The informal question concerns the distribution of residues in the sumset A+A (counts divided by |A+A|), but the formal statement filters and counts elements of A itself (divided by sqrt(N)), formalizing the Lindström variant for A rather than the stated sumset question; no quantifier misordering is evident.

fcpr:9002c58e81d6f5b23c56cbcd88a3ee99c74.rationale: The informal statement asks to determine the supremum of admissible exponents, but the formal statement uses IsGreatest, which additionally requires the extremal exponent α to itself belong to the admissible set (i.e., the supremum is attained), an extra condition beyond the informal 'supremum'.

fcpr:714aaf5beb083dd071ce09ac8f8e15e4c37.rationale: The conjunction ¬n.Prime ∧ 1 < n is exactly the definition of composite (excluding 0 and 1, which are neither prime nor composite), so the hinted extra hypothesis 1 < n is in fact part of the informal notion and the formalization is faithful.

fcpr:064daf7ed8fa6f206fb84647f3a6dc91649.rationale: Mathlib's IsConnected bundles a nonemptiness requirement on {z : |p(z)| ≤ 1} beyond the informal 'connected' hypothesis, adding an extra assumption (though it is essentially automatic for nonconstant p, weakening the ∀-statement only formally).

fcpr:e39d2075c02ed0e9c0d4caddfc69ec7d20f.rationale: The hypothesis `2 * V'.ncard + 1 ≥ Fintype.card V` means |V'| ≥ (n-1)/2 rather than the informal threshold |V'| ≥ n/2, an off-by-one on the subgraph size bound, which inside the answer-iff makes the statement incomparable.

fcpr:9cddd0ab157fb101a83eb179a1eaa5ea0cb.rationale: In ZMod 2 the notation `2 • A` elaborates to the pointwise image {2 • a | a ∈ A} = {0} rather than the sumset A + A, so the guaranteed coset must lie in {0} and the statement is trivially satisfied by F ≡ 0, contrary to the intended sumset question.

fcpr:10efdc97e18a2c87e41719ef1ce39bbf9fd.rationale: The number of translates is ⌊C * p^θ⌋₊ instead of the O(p^{1-θ}) demanded by the informal note, which the docstring itself explains makes the inner conjecture trivially false by pigeonhole, so the answer(False) statement becomes trivially true rather than capturing the intended open question.

fcpr:50d3bdc5f24d6b2ddcda97a856c5088be52.rationale: The definedness of g is checked at the ℚ-valued point of constant coefficients (constantCoeff ∘ pt), i.e. at z = 0, rather than at the power-series point itself, requiring the denominator to be a unit power series instead of merely nonzero as the informal equation f^{(n)} = g(...) demands.

fcpr:451d109ab49055a3bdbea7f015c09c1086f.rationale: The informal statement (per the paper's convention) requires the space to be compact Hausdorff, but the formal existential omits the T2Space (Hausdorff) condition, making the required example strictly easier to provide.

The theorem merely unfolds an opaque auxiliary proposition, and per the reviewer hint that proposition quantifies the space wrongly (e.g. universally rather than asserting existence of an example), though the definition body is not visible to verify the direction.

fcpr:accf2eceb8f8f4bc0272b0ccc95daa96423.rationale: The implication structure is scrambled: the formal statement asserts (d_s(A+B) > d_s(B) ∧ 0 < d_s(B)) → d_s(B) < 1, making the intended conclusion d_s(A+B) > d_s(B) a hypothesis and the side condition d_s(B) < 1 the conclusion, instead of (0 < d_s(B) < 1) → d_s(A+B) > d_s(B).

fcpr:e39d2075c02ed0e9c0d4caddfc69ec7d20f.rationale: The summation `∑ m ≤ N` ranges over Finset.Iic N and thus includes an extraneous m = 0 term (informal sum is over 1 ≤ m ≤ N), an off-by-one in the summation bound, though the displayed denominator √(N log log N) and limsup otherwise match the informal statement.

fcpr:13de6c419bb3448be874a1a384b078b18e9.rationale: The informal problem asks for a covering whose cosets all have pairwise different sizes (∀ i ≠ j, sizes differ), but the formal statement only requires some pair of cosets to differ in size (∃ i j), a much weaker condition trivially satisfiable by ordinary coverings.

fcpr:451d109ab49055a3bdbea7f015c09c1086f.rationale: The hypothesis `Fact (ℵ₁ = 𝔠)` is a standard encoding of CH and the conclusion names exactly the intended existence proposition, so despite the vacuous-or-trivial hint no trivializing feature is substantiable from the visible statement (any vacuity would have to reside in the unseen auxiliary definition).
